name: Imouto ga Heya ni Iru
original_name: イモウトが部屋にいる
source:
I'm a HikiNEET who doesn't leave my room,
so when my little sister came in, I was annoyed.

"What do you want!?" I asked

Might as well find out, right?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE275202.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我是一个不离开房间的HikiNEET，
所以当我的小妹妹进来时，我很生气。

“你想要什么！？”我问

或许也能找出来，对吧？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE275202.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
